caption: This is a miniature of the backrooms. This model captures the endless, repetitive geometry of a school corridor at night, built with painstaking detail using wood, metal, and fabric. Each locker and doorway is perfectly aligned to create a sense of infinite scale across the workbench. Deep within the maze, a small figure remains, still searching for any door that might actually lead outside.
